validation_ack.reason: PUT II rights issue: 14,854,603,468 new shares were issued 16-23 Nov 2020, so the year-end count (38,813,641,319; AR2020 PDF p. 10) is far above the weighted-average shares behind the printed basic EPS; the EPS is also printed rounded to Rp0.005 on a profit of only Rp0.128bn (AR2020 PDF p. 8). 0.005 x 38,813,641,319 = Rp0.194bn vs Rp0.128bn; with ~25.5bn weighted shares (23,959,037,851 for the full year + the new shares for ~38 days) 0.128bn / 25.5bn = Rp0.0050, i.e. the printed figure.

research_notes: IDENTITY: PNBS = PT Bank Panin Dubai Syariah Tbk (brand 'Panin Dubai Syariah Bank', abbreviation PDSB; formerly PT Bank Panin Syariah Tbk, renamed 2016 after Dubai Islamic Bank PJSC became a shareholder). Full-fledged sharia commercial bank, listed 15 Jan 2014. Controlling shareholder PT Bank Pan Indonesia Tbk (PNBN): 53.70% before the Nov 2020 rights issue, 69.93% after it, 67.30% from Feb/Mar 2021 after Panin sold 1,020.5m shares (PNBN FS2021 PDF p. 17); Dubai Islamic Bank PJSC is the other major shareholder. 1% of the shares (held by Panin Bank) is not listed on IDX by law (PP 29/1999), which is why some tables show 99% of the share count. PNBS has no subsidiaries (AR2020 PDF p. 39), so its entity statements are stored with basis 'consolidated' and its regulatory ratios with basis 'bank_only'.

SOURCE ACCESS (read first): the old IR domain paninbanksyariah.co.id (and panindubaisyariah.co.id) no longer resolves; the current site www.pdsb.co.id sits behind an F5/Volterra WAF that answers this server with 'The requested URL was rejected' (HTTP 403) and has also refused the Internet Archive since Nov 2025 (CDX: 403 for every capture after 2025-11-07); idx.co.id is Cloudflare-blocked; ojk.go.id does not connect. No challenge was bypassed. pdsb.co.id serves every document through Laravel-encrypted download links (/about/download_ar/<token>, /about/download_lapkeu_*/<token>); the Archive captured the HTML listing pages (AR 2018-2024, quarterly/annual FS 2018-Q1 2025, monthly reports, sustainability reports are all listed on the 18 Jul 2025 capture of /about/laporan_keuangan) but NONE of those AR/FS download links. Archived and complete: the RUPS documents 2019-2024, the prospectuses (incl. PUT II 2020) and the Pillar-3 risk-exposure reports; the GCG reports 2014-2023 are archived truncated at 1 MiB (a few pages recoverable). The old-domain annual reports (AR2019, AR2020, AR2021) and sustainability reports are archived only TRUNCATED at 1 MiB: AR2020 pages 1-~60 (highlights, ratios, share table) were recovered with scripts/salvage_pdf.py; AR2019/AR2021 yield no data pages. KSEI hosts the issuer's own AGMS summaries for 2025 and 2026 (fetched directly). Broker/aggregator copies of PNBS's IDX filings exist (e.g. indopremier.com) but were NOT used (brief: no aggregators; source_url must be on the bank's/IDX's domain).

FY2021-FY2025 LEVELS AND RATIOS COME FROM THE PARENT'S FILINGS: because no PNBS AR/FS after FY2020 is retrievable, total assets, equity, EPS and the regulatory ratios (CAR, NPF gross/net, ROA, ROE, BOPO, FDR) for FY2021-FY2025 are taken from the annual reports of PT Bank Pan Indonesia Tbk ('Kinerja Keuangan PDSB' section of the MD&A, values in Rp billion as printed) and, for FY2021-FY2022 assets/equity, from the PSAK 67 summarized financial information of PDSB in the parent's audited FS (exact Rp juta). Net profit FY2022-FY2025 is PNBS's own figure from its AGMS summaries (exact to the rupiah). Cross-checks: the parent's figures equal PNBS's own AR2020 for FY2020 (assets 11,302,082; equity 3,115,653; profit 128; CAR 31.43%; NPF 3.38/2.45%; ROA 0.06%; ROE 0.01%; BOPO 99.42%; FDR 111.71%) and PNBS's AGMS profit for FY2022 (250,531,591,141). For FY2023 the parent's FS note shows profit 244,432 vs PNBS's AGMS 244,690 (Rp juta) and equity 2,788,265 vs AR 2,789 bn, i.e. a small consolidation-level difference, so the AR (PNBS-reported) values are stored for FY2023-FY2025. loans_gross, deposits, NOM, CIR, CoC, coverage and CASA for FY2021-FY2025 are null: the parent's section does not print them. LaR is filled only for FY2022/FY2023 with PNBS's PKR (Pembiayaan Kualitas Rendah) ratio from its own GCG report 2023 (23.85% / 17.70%); that report's other figures look preliminary (FY2023 'laba setelah pajak Rp254,1 Milyar' = profit before zakat and tax, BOPO 81.19%, ROE 10.75%, KPMM 20.93% vs AR 244.69bn / 80.55% / 10.44% / 20.50%), so only the PKR (available nowhere else) is used from it. PNBS's GCG report 2022 confirms the FY2022 BOPO/ROA/ROE (76.99% / 1.79% / 11.51%) taken from the parent's AR2022.

RESTATEMENTS (reviewer check): PNBS restated FY2023 in its FY2024 FS (parent AR2024 PDF p. 224, marked 'Disajikan kembali'): assets 17,343 -> 17,326, equity 2,789 -> 2,771, net profit 245 (AGMS 244.690) -> 228, EPS 6.30 -> 5.86, CAR 20.50 -> 20.39%, NPF net 3.03 -> 2.95%, ROA 1.62 -> 1.51%, ROE 10.44 -> 9.71%, BOPO 80.55 -> 82.47%. It restated FY2024 again in its FY2025 FS (parent AR2025 PDF p. 250, '*) Disajikan kembali'): assets 16,797 -> 16,838, equity 2,852 -> 2,899, net profit 89 (AGMS 88.568) -> 136, EPS 2.28 -> 3.50, CAR 21.94 -> 22.01%. The reason is not given in the parent's AR and PNBS's own FS (which would explain it) are not retrievable. fy.2023 and fy.2024 store the figures as originally reported (and approved by the AGMS); the restated values are in each datum's note. Growth FY2023->FY2024 and FY2024->FY2025 computed from stored levels therefore mixes bases.

NO DIVIDENDS FY2020-FY2025 (payout_ratio v 0 for every year): every AGMS retained the whole year's result to strengthen core capital - FY2020 (AGMS 29 Jul 2021), FY2021 loss year, 'tidak ada pembagian dividen' and no zakat (AGMS 29 Jun 2022), FY2022 (21 Jun 2023), FY2023 (5 Jun 2024), FY2024 (18 Jun 2025, KSEI copy), FY2025 (10 Jun 2026, KSEI copy). FY2019 and FY2018 were also fully retained (AGMS 27 Jul 2020, 19 Jun 2019).
